text:
I see you are experiencing fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance. To better understand what might be going on, have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements or the amount of urine you produce?

REQUEST TEST: TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone)

speaker: Doctor
text:
That TSH level is significantly elevated, which strongly suggests hypothyroidism. Have you noticed any dry skin, hair thinning, or swelling in your face or hands?

REQUEST TEST: Free T4

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Hypothyroidism (likely Hashimoto's thyroiditis). Given the elevated TSH and low Free T4, your thyroid is underactive. Are you currently taking any medications, especially lithium or amiodarone, that could affect thyroid function?
